definitions: A development package in Debian/Ubuntu-based Linux distributions that provides the necessary header files and static libraries for developing applications that use OpenSSL.
Refers to the development files for the Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) library.
examples: To compile the application, you need to install libssl-dev.
The build failed because libssl-dev was missing.
Installing libssl-dev is a common step for many open-source projects.
